<thought>To determine the number of CH₃ groups, I will obtain the ¹H NMR spectrum of the sample (no SMILES needed). The spectrum will list peaks with their chemical shifts and integration values. Methyl protons appear as signals integrating to 3 H (or multiples thereof) and typically appear upfield (≈0.8–1.5 ppm). By counting distinct methyl signals (considering symmetry), I can infer the number of CH₃ groups.</thought>
